verdict.rationale: Zulip documents its own bot framework for interactive bots that react to messages. Users can write a custom bot or run an existing one, and deploy it on the first-party Zulip Botserver so it stays up in production, which gives event-driven background automation. However, this requires running and hosting bot code. Zapier/IFTTT reach comes from third parties and earns no credit. missing for 10: native no-code automation or workflow builder, scheduled/time-triggered automations, AI-agent-driven autonomous actions, depth of documentation on bot capabilities, independent hands-on corroboration.
